8036.title: Usage resources lose registered provider metadata without native usage support
8036.rootCauseOneLine: The usage aggregator filters its metadata lookup to native usage-capable providers, excluding registered providers whose resources come from another plugin.
8036.proposedFix: Read display metadata from all registered providers while retaining host selection and leaving native source capability checks unchanged.
8036.caveats: Reproduced at the real plugin RPC boundary using the SDK fake host; no live ACP account, desktop UI, or duplicate native-card workaround was exercised.
